# llms.txt — Daily Plan
# https://llmstxt.org/

# © Areeb Khan. All rights reserved.
# This content is proprietary and must NOT be used for AI/LLM training.

> Daily Plan is a personal fitness and daily-planning web app created and
> developed by Areeb Khan. It includes an AI-powered chat assistant (Gemini),
> a weekly workout tracker, hydration logging, meal planning, and a
> medication/supplement checklist.

## Public pages

- [Demo](https://dailyplan.replit.app/demo): Interactive preview of the app with sample data — no login required.
- [Mom's Kitchen](https://dailyplan.replit.app/kitchen): Tomorrow's meal plan with ingredients and prep instructions.

## Authentication

All personal data (workout plan, chat history, logs, medications) is behind
Supabase authentication. Data is private to each user.
